description: If a player places a piece in any corner of the board, they get an extra turn.

description: If a player plays a card that is lower than the last played card by the opponent, their score for that turn is subtracted instead of added.

description: If a player plays a card that exactly matches the last played card, that player's score resets to zero.

description: If a player plays a card that exactly matches the last card played by the opponent, the current player's score is halved.

replay.mechanic_description: If a player plays a card that exactly matches the last card played by the opponent, the current player's score is halved.

description: If a player plays a card with a value of 8 or higher, they must discard an additional random card from their hand.

description: If the current player's score is less than the opponent's score, the value of the card played by the current player is doubled for that turn.

description: If a player plays a card that has the same value as the previous card played by either player, they get an extra turn.

replay.mechanic_description: If a player plays a card that has the same value as the previous card played by either player, they get an extra turn.

description: If a player plays a card with a value of 3 or less, both players immediately draw one new card from the deck.

description: If a player plays a card with a value of 8 or higher, they draw an additional card at the end of their turn.

replay.mechanic_description: If a player plays a card with a value of 8 or higher, they draw an additional card at the end of their turn.

description: If a player plays a card with a value of 3 or less, they draw a new card and also gain 2 bonus points.

replay.mechanic_description: If a player plays a card with a value of 3 or less, they draw a new card and also gain 2 bonus points.

description: If a player places a piece within the central 2x2 squares (indices 2,2 to 3,3), that piece cannot be part of a winning line for the next turn.

description: After a player places a piece, the two squares directly orthogonal to the last move, in the direction facing away from the center of the board, are blocked for the next turn for both players.

replay.mechanic_description: After a player places a piece, the two squares directly orthogonal to the last move, in the direction facing away from the center of the board, are blocked for the next turn for both players.

description: When a player places a piece on an empty square, if that square is on the outermost edge of the board, the immediately adjacent empty square towards the center (if one exists) becomes temporarily blocked for the opponent's next turn.
